name: Verdant
source:
Class: Paladin

Quiet, responsible, and mature, Verdant is the online and game persona of Julian's mysterious guildmate.

The two are close friends, and Verdant cares deeply for him, but Julian knows nothing about his IRL identity. Who really is Verdant behind the screen?

[From [url=https://gallium-games.itch.io/guilded-hearts]official page[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Jianyu.[/spoiler]
